json.notes: Coit Tower is a single round reinforced-concrete tower on a hilltop, about 64 m high. Its plain fluted shaft rises from a wider base and ends in an open arcaded crown of tall arched openings. The main signature is the round shaft with the arcaded belfry at the top; the surrounding park and drive are not modelled.
